resources.name: Preview Hider (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: The Preview Hider resource pack addresses visual alterations introduced in preview and beta builds of the game, aiming to restore a more familiar and established appearance.

resources.name: SERP Aditions (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Creature collecting gets new tools, tiers and breeding with SERP Aditions, an add-on that also touches mining, cooking and crafting.

resources.name: VietNam Military (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Firearms and gear from the Vietnam War fill VietNam Military, an add-on with assault rifles like the AKM and M16A1, light machine guns such as the RPD and M60, and heavier weapons including the M79…

resources.name: The Man from the Shadow (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: A dark figure that pursues players from the shadows is the centerpiece of The Man from the Shadow, a horror add-on.

resources.name: GTV DODGE CARS (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Dodge muscle cars with real driving mechanics arrive with GTV DODGE CARS, an add-on that needs Experimental Features turned on.

resources.name: Roll and Stamina: Parkour Expansion (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Slides, wall runs, vaults and safety rolls give you more ways to move with Roll and Stamina: Parkour Expansion, an addon that builds on the base Roll and Stamina addon.

resources.name: NARUTO CRAFT (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Naruto, Sasuke, Sakura, Hinata and Kakashi show up as new mobs in NARUTO CRAFT, an add-on inspired by the Naruto series.

resources.name: Tree Physics (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Tree Physics makes trees fall as a whole when chopped, instead of vanishing block by block.

resources.name: Nitro (26+, 1.16) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Low-resolution 8×8 textures, half the size of standard ones, keep Nitro light on less powerful computers while staying colorful and stylish.

resources.name: Bob Golems (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: More than fifty new golem types stand guard in Bob Golems, an add-on for players who find the standard Iron Golem a little predictable.

resources.name: The Everything Update Add-on Pack (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: The Everything Update Add-on Pack merges several earlier content additions into one large package that reaches from the deepest caves to the heights of The End.

resources.name: Dupe Command (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Dupe Command lets players duplicate the item they are holding by typing a simple command.

resources.name: Energistics (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Energistics adds machinery for energy generation, resource processing and automated tasks, each machine with its own custom interface.

resources.name: Easy Redstone (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Redstone builds become easier to read with Easy Redstone, a resource pack that streamlines the look of technical constructions.

resources.name: Lovely Robots (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Eight robot companions with their own combat styles are the heart of Lovely Robots, an addon that needs both the behavior and resource packs applied.

resources.name: A Tinkerer’s Legacy: Armory Additions (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: New armor sets with passive effects expand the Tinkers Legacy lineup in A Tinkerer’s Legacy: Armory Additions, an add-on that does not modify player.json and so stays compatible with most other…

resources.name: Simple Backrooms (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: An endless Backrooms dimension below the normal world is the setting of Simple Backrooms, an add-on that needs Experimental Features turned on for its scripting APIs.

resources.name: Dma’s Framed Blocks (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Twelve framed block shapes that can wear almost any full block texture are the draw of Dma’s Framed Blocks, an add-on for detailed building.

resources.name: Nico’s More Mineshaft (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: New mineshafts generate naturally underground with Nico’s More Mineshaft, each type with its own design, length and loot table.

resources.name: Keep Inventory (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Items stay in the inventory after death with Keep Inventory, an add-on that brings the familiar vanilla mechanic without requiring cheats.

resources.name: Adventures Structures (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Over 75 pre-designed structures appear in the world with Adventures Structures, an add-on compatible with the Jigsaw Worldgen system.

resources.name: Dew Ore Vein Miner (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: A whole ore vein breaks at once with Dew Ore Vein Miner, an addon for faster resource gathering.

resources.name: Auto Totem Equipment “Smart Totem Safety System” (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: A Totem of Undying lands in the offhand on its own with Auto Totem Equipment “Smart Totem Safety System”, an add-on that watches the player’s health in real time.

resources.name: Comes Alive Edition (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Comes Alive Edition adds companion characters that gather resources for the player once they are given stone tools.

resources.name: Builder’s Wands (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Placing many blocks at once is what Builder’s Wands is for, an add-on with seven wands, from the Wooden to the Netherite Builder Wand, including a Creative one.

resources.name: Ender Awakening (26+, 1.20) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: New biomes, creatures and items arrive in the End with Ender Awakening, an add-on that keeps a familiar look while changing how the dimension feels.

resources.name: Debug Stick (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Debug Stick adds a tool familiar from Java Edition that edits block properties directly in the world. Experimental Features must be enabled for this add-on.

resources.name: ADD-ON STRANGER THINGS (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: ADD-ON STRANGER THINGS brings monsters, weapons and bosses inspired by the popular series, many of which show up during a normal survival playthrough.

resources.name: More Vanilla Tools (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: More Vanilla Tools adds new tool tiers made from materials already in the game: amethyst, copper and emerald.

resources.name: Construct Addon (1.26.50) – Build Perfect Structures with Holographic Blueprints
resources.summary: Construct Addon projects holographic blueprints directly into your Bedrock world to guide your survival builds. It shows you where every block belongs so you never misplace a wall or roof. The addon checks your work and marks any wrong blocks in real time. It lets you rebuild your favorite creations from creative mode without guessing. […]

resources.name: Not Just A Waifu (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Zombies are replaced by a cast of female characters in Not Just A Waifu, an add-on that reimagines the usual undead threat.

resources.name: FlyerWork Vanilla Aircraft & Plane (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Ten aircraft, from simple gliders to supersonic jets, fly in FlyerWork Vanilla Aircraft & Plane, an addon that needs Experimental Features and both the behavior and resource packs applied.

resources.name: Raiyon’s Hammers Excavators (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Hammers and Excavators arrive in Raiyon’s Hammers Excavators, an add-on with new tools inspired by popular Java mods.

resources.name: From The Forest (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: An elusive entity called The Shifter hunts players in From The Forest, an add-on that needs Experimental Features turned on.

resources.name: Phase Blocks by Four (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Walls you can walk through make hidden bases easy with Phase Blocks by Four.

resources.name: Ultimate Vein Miner (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: One swing clears a whole ore vein with Ultimate Vein Miner: connected ore blocks within a six-block radius break together, with effects and sounds.

resources.name: Creepypasta Expansion (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Creepypasta legends walk the world in Creepypasta Expansion, an add-on that adds unsettling figures such as Herobrine, Null, Slenderman and Pennywise.

resources.name: Biome Compass (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: The Biome Compass introduces a new tool that helps players locate any biome across the game’s dimensions.

resources.name: Raiyon’s More Maces (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Over a dozen new maces, each with its own properties, join the game with Raiyon’s More Maces, an add-on that offers new combat options.

resources.name: Nether’s Delight (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: New Nether cooking blocks, Hoglin cuts and machetes expand the food system in Nether’s Delight, an addon that works as a companion to Farmer’s Delight.

resources.name: True Java Saturation (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Healing depends on a hidden saturation value in True Java Saturation, an add-on that copies the food saturation system from Java Edition.

resources.name: Complete Capitator (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Complete Capitator packs four harvesting tools in one add-on: a vein miner, a tree capitator, a crop capitator and a shear capitator, and it needs experimental features turned on.

resources.name: More Zombies by Four (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Zombies stop looking identical with More Zombies by Four, an add-on that replaces the single familiar blue-shirted look with many different clothing and skin textures.

resources.name: Vanilla Hammers (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Mining a three-by-three area becomes possible with Vanilla Hammers, an add-on that adds a set of new tools.

resources.name: Poppy Playtime (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Poppy Playtime brings characters inspired by the popular horror game series into the world as new entities and mechanics.

resources.name: The Prowler Patch FR (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: The Prowler Patch FR adds a horror creature, the Prowler, that stalks players during the night and in dark areas.

resources.name: RPG Damage Indicator (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: RPG Damage Indicator gives every mob and enemy a health bar in the style of role-playing games.

resources.name: Better NightVision (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Night vision becomes a single click with Better NightVision, an add-on that adds an item for instantly toggling it, with no commands or potions needed.

resources.name: Paper Pokemon by Four (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: A paper-style, two-dimensional look and a catching system come together in Paper Pokemon by Four, an add-on that needs Experimental Features enabled.

resources.name: The PewDiePack (26+, 1.14) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Custom splash messages, a new logo and a fresh background greet you at launch with The PewDiePack, a themed pack for fans of that internet personality.

resources.name: Dorios’ Trinkets (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Over eighty trinkets with special effects and stat bonuses come with Dorios’ Trinkets, an add-on that needs Experimental Features turned on.

resources.name: Nissan R35 GTR 370Z Car Addon Pack (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Two sports cars, the R35 GTR and the 370Z, drive into the game with Nissan R35 GTR 370Z Car Addon Pack, an add-on with fully functional vehicles.

resources.name: AppleSkin (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Food tooltips show exactly how much hunger and saturation each item restores with AppleSkin, an unofficial addon port of a well-known Java Edition feature.

resources.name: Vein Miner (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Breaking one ore block takes out every connected ore block with Vein Miner, which makes clearing a vein quick.

resources.name: Tool Swapper (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Tool Swapper gives players a tool belt that holds a set of tools, so they can be reached without opening the inventory.

resources.name: Backpacks by Four (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Portable storage that does not clutter the interface comes with Backpacks by Four, an add-on that adds backpacks in fifteen colors, plus Catpack versions in Black, Gray, Tabby and White.

resources.name: BONY162 Furniture (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Kitchens, bedrooms and bathrooms can be fully furnished with BONY162 Furniture, an add-on with over 100 decorative blocks and items.

resources.name: Mythological Craft (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Mythological Craft fills the world with fantasy creatures such as giants, goblins and dragons.

resources.name: Security Cameras (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Security Cameras lets players place customizable cameras around the world and watch them from anywhere with a tablet item.

resources.name: Instant Structures (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Pre-designed buildings and natural features can be placed instantly with Instant Structures, which adds a single selector item.

resources.name: Expedition Backpacks (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Wearable backpacks give players extra room for items in Expedition Backpacks, an add-on with several functional designs.

resources.name: Warthunder WW2 (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: World War II tanks and aircraft arrive with Warthunder WW2, an addon of historically inspired vehicles that requires Experimental Features.

resources.name: Village Generator (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Whole settlements appear instantly with Village Generator, an add-on that is especially useful on superflat maps.

resources.name: Nico’s Item Expansion (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: New items, tools and crafting options arrive with Nico’s Item Expansion, an add-on that needs Experimental Features turned on because it relies on scripting APIs.

resources.name: Endless Fabulous v0.7-beta Addon (26.x) – Wield Godly Armor and Infinity Weapons
resources.summary: Endless Fabulous v0.7-beta Addon adds extremely powerful endgame weapons, tools, and armor sets to your world. It allows you to craft the Armor of Infinity, wield weapons with infinite damage, and collect rare cosmic materials. You can also build special machines like the Extreme Crafting Table and Neutron Collectors to unlock ultimate gear. Features: Armor […]

resources.name: Villager Minion (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Cages that hold villagers, wandering traders and golems are the core of Villager Minion, an add-on for tidier trading setups.

resources.name: Pokemon Adventures! Eevee (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Pokemon are pets rather than fighters in Pokemon Adventures! Eevee, an add-on about care and companionship.

resources.name: Crossbattle / Port from Java (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Modern firearms and tactical gear fill Crossbattle / Port from Java, a faithful recreation of a Java Edition mod.

resources.name: Ghost Block (26+, 1.20) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Blocks that can be walked through are the idea behind Ghost Block, an add-on for secret passages, hidden rooms and traps.

resources.name: All In One Tool (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: The All In One Tool addon introduces a versatile item that consolidates the functions of several traditional tools into a single unit.

resources.name: Health Bars (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: A pixel-art health bar appears above a mob’s head after it takes damage with Health Bars, an add-on that makes fights easier to read.

resources.name: The Forgotten Legends (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: A dark fantasy world of undead, orcs and drakes arrives with The Forgotten Legends, an add-on that adds creatures, equipment, structures and a magic system.

resources.name: Ore Finder (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: A handheld scanner finds nearby ore through sounds, on-screen messages and optional particles with Ore Finder, an addon that offers a fair alternative to X-ray cheats in survival.

resources.name: Actual Knives (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Detailed 3D knives take the place of the default swords in Actual Knives, an add-on with a collection of eleven realistic melee weapons.

resources.name: RuneCraft (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: RuneCraft reworks survival into something closer to an old online role-playing game, with new metals, skills, creatures and structures.

resources.name: Lightning Magic (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: An ancient lightning blade that electrifies foes with every strike sits at the heart of Lightning Magic, an add-on that builds a full electrical magic system.

resources.name: Vanilla Upgrade (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Familiar-feeling extras for automation, combat and survival arrive with Vanilla Upgrade, an add-on that aims to match the style of the original game.

resources.name: Horned Helmet (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Horned Helmet gives diamond, gold, iron and netherite helmets a dash ability. Experimental Features must be enabled for this add-on.

resources.name: Physics- (26+, 1.20) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Physics- gives blocks physical effects, so a mined block breaks into small fragments that scatter briefly before disappearing.

resources.name: ACT WEAPONS (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: ACT WEAPONS adds tactical firearms with custom 3D models and smooth mechanical animations.

resources.name: Integrated Storage (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: An infinitely expandable storage network is the centerpiece of Integrated Storage, an add-on for collecting, organizing and retrieving items through connected terminals.

resources.name: OverStack “break the 64 Stack limite” (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Inventory slots hold far more items with OverStack “break the 64 Stack limite”, an addon that goes past the usual stack limit.

resources.name: Offhand Android Mod (26.52) – Real Java-Style Offhand for MCPE on LeviLauncher
resources.summary: Offhand Android Mod finally brings a real, Java-style offhand to Minecraft Bedrock on Android. Vanilla Bedrock only lets you put a few items like shields, totems and maps in your second hand, but this native LeviLauncher mod lets you hold almost anything there – a torch, a pickaxe, food or blocks – and actually use […]

resources.name: InSaRe’s Warfare UPDATE SOON (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Over 45 guns, grenades and tactical gear come in InSaRe’s Warfare UPDATE SOON, an add-on for PvP with a simple but realistic style.

resources.name: End’s Delight (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Chorus fruit and the Ender Dragon become cooking ingredients in End’s Delight, an add-on that extends Farmer’s Delight and needs it active to work.

resources.name: BMW Cars (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: High-performance cars and SUVs from BMW drive into the game with BMW Cars, an add-on with working engines and handling.

resources.name: Crafting Gives 32767 Enchantments! (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Tools and armor with the highest possible enchantment levels come out of a special crafting recipe in Crafting Gives 32767 Enchantments!.

resources.name: Weapons Plus (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: A set of balanced 3D weapons is what Weapons Plus adds, all keeping a vanilla look.

resources.name: ChillCraft Music Pack (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Calm lo-fi remixes of familiar in-game melodies replace the usual soundtrack with ChillCraft Music Pack, an add-on with a large set of tracks.

resources.name: Simple AutoSmelt (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Raw iron, copper, gold and ancient debris come out as finished ingots or netherite scrap the moment you mine them with Simple AutoSmelt, an addon that removes the need for furnaces and fuel.

resources.name: Crystalcraft Unlimited (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Crystalcraft Unlimited adds a large set of new ores and gemstones across all dimensions, used to craft tools, armor and decorative blocks.

resources.name: System Enchantements (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: System Enchantements replaces the usual enchanting with a Mysterious Enchantment Table that offers a random pick of enchantments.

resources.name: The End ! (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: A progressive apocalypse unfolds in The End !, which starts once the Pandora’s Box is crafted and broken and the Totem of Armageddon is summoned.

resources.name: Just Cosmetics (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Hundreds of hats and outfits are on offer in Just Cosmetics, an add-on that lets players customize their character without giving up protection.

resources.name: Vampirism (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Vampirism lets players become a vampire, with unique abilities and vulnerabilities. Experimental Features must be enabled for this add-on.

resources.name: Fiery Combat X FAnimation (26+, 1.20) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Fiery Combat X FAnimation overhauls player combat with new broadswords and katanas in diamond, iron and netherite.

resources.name: Siren Head the Siren’s Field Addon (26.x, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock
resources.summary: Siren Head: The Siren’s Field Addon brings the iconic horror creature created by Trevor Henderson into your game. It adds towering hostile entities that roam the wilderness at night and hunt down unsuspecting targets. This addon delivers an intense survival horror experience with custom sounds and deadly combat mechanics. Features: Adds Siren Head with 80,000 […]

resources.name: Titans of Extinction Dinosaurs & Zombie Apocalypse Addon (26.x, 1.21)
resources.summary: Titans of Extinction: Dinosaurs & Zombie Apocalypse Addon brings a prehistoric apocalypse filled with prehistoric beasts and undead monsters to your world. It lets you tame baby dinosaurs, discover giant ancient structures, and collect new armor sets. You can fight off corrupted creatures while riding powerful mounts across wild new biomes. Features: Adds dangerous prehistoric […]

resources.name: Bob Golems+ Addon (26.x, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock
resources.summary: Bob Golems+ Addon introduces over 50 unique golem types crafted from many standard building blocks. Players can create defenders out of wood, glass, magma, and diamond to guard their bases from monsters. Each golem features distinct combat abilities, health stats, and traits to assist in survival. Features: Adds over 50 new golems made from various […]

resources.name: Java MobCap (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Java MobCap changes how creatures populate the world so that mob spawning behaves like it does in Java Edition.

resources.name: Jurassic World Saga (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Dinosaurs from the whole film saga, from the original Jurassic Park to Jurassic World Dominion and Camp Cretaceous, populate Jurassic World Saga, an add-on that also brings new equipment, vehicles…

resources.name: Mo’ Creatures Add-on (26+, 1.20) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: 57 new creatures, plus new blocks and items, fill the world with Mo’ Creatures Add-on, an add-on that keeps growing with more animals planned.

resources.name: Blocklings (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Living versions of ores follow you around as pets in Blocklings, an add-on where you tame mineral creatures.

resources.name: Fishing Is Op (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Casting a line becomes a hunt for powerful gear with Fishing Is Op, an add-on that replaces the usual fish and junk with rare rewards.

resources.name: Invincible (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Heroes, villains, custom armor and weapons from the comic and animated series arrive in Invincible, an add-on that ends in the Invincible War with eighteen variants.

resources.name: Dinosaur Saga Add-On (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: A combat system with new weapon types and defensive maneuvers, plus creatures such as Albertosaurus, Megaloceros and Tylosaurus Proriger, makes up Dinosaur Saga Add-On, which draws on…

resources.name: Plants vs Zombies Classic (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Survival turns into tower defense with Plants vs Zombies Classic, which brings nearly every plant and most zombies from the classic game.

resources.name: Spears of Mayhem Add-On (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: A new melee weapon type arrives with Spears of Mayhem Add-On, which adds spears modeled on the early Java Edition snapshot version.

resources.name: OP Item Rain Addon (1.21) – Random Overpowered Loot Drops Falling From the Sky
resources.summary: OP Item Rain Addon periodically showers your world with random items and extremely overpowered loot. You can collect powerful enchanted equipment to help you beat the game faster. The custom menu also gives you full control over drop rates, timers, and lag cleanup. Features: Rains random items and rare overpowered gear from above. Includes a […]

resources.name: Falsity Mod Addon (26.x) – Survive Terrifying Stalker Entities Lurking
resources.summary: Falsity Mod Addon brings a creepy survival horror experience to your Minecraft world. It adds terrifying stalker entities that follow players and hunt them down as they explore. The creature creates tense survival moments and reacts when players hit other mobs. Features: Adds a dangerous stalker entity that actively hunts players. Introduces unique monsters including […]

resources.name: Old Netherite Upgrade (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Diamond gear upgrades to netherite without a smithing template through Old Netherite Upgrade, a behavior pack that brings back the earlier crafting method.

resources.name: Enchantments (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Enchantments adds new magical abilities that players find at a standard enchanting table, just like vanilla enchantments.

resources.name: Archaism Talismans (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Archaism Talismans adds over 396 new items to the game, including talismans, trinkets and armor sets, along with jewelry upgrades and more magic options for summoner builds.

resources.name: Nico’s Cave Expansion (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: New cave types, creatures, plants, edible items, mineral deposits and tools arrive with Nico’s Cave Expansion, an add-on that expands underground exploration.

resources.name: Mr. Nido’s The Boys (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: A chaotic, superpowered cast shows up in Mr. Nido’s The Boys, an add-on that requires Experimental Features because it uses scripting APIs.

resources.name: Magical Warfare (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Magical Warfare adds a magic system where elemental spells replace traditional weapons. It uses scripting APIs, so Experimental Features must be turned on.

resources.name: DC LEGENDS (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Inspired by the DC Comics universe, DC LEGENDS brings familiar characters and abilities into the game, along with new combat mechanics, unique miners and structures.

resources.name: Drone , TNT Drones (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Drone , TNT Drones adds a controllable drone that players can fly to explore the world from a new perspective.

resources.name: Sanity: Descent Into Madness (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Mental health becomes a stat to manage with Sanity: Descent Into Madness, an add-on that adds a sanity mechanic inspired by a popular survival game.

resources.name: Xadurgie Entity Xaier (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Endless night and creeping corruption define Xadurgie Entity Xaier, an analog horror-inspired addon that requires Experimental Features and both packs applied.

resources.name: Rings and Relics (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: A set of new accessory items with unique mechanics comes with Rings and Relics, an add-on that adds over 35 items.

resources.name: Lootr (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Every player gets their own loot from chests, barrels and shulker boxes with Lootr, an add-on that makes the contents of such containers specific to each person.

resources.name: Warden Equipment (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: Gear made from Warden drops is the focus of Warden Equipment, an add-on with a full armor set, Echo tools and an Echo Staff.

resources.name: xHarderCore – Hydration (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: A thirst bar that works much like the hunger bar is added by xHarderCore – Hydration, an add-on that makes water a real survival need.

resources.name: System Hydra (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon
resources.summary: System Hydra adds a Hydra boss with elemental variants: Electric, Fire, Ice and Poison.

resources.name: Brewin’ And Chewin’ (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Addon

resources.name: Enchantment Icons (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack
resources.summary: Colored pixel-art icons appear beside every enchantment name in inventory tooltips with Enchantment Icons, a texture pack that makes enchantments quick to recognize without reading long descriptions.

resources.name: Better 3D Beds (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack

resources.name: Saturation Vibrant Visual HD (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Shader
resources.summary: Color intensity is adjustable in Saturation Vibrant Visual HD, a shader pack that comes with subpacks for choosing a saturation level before entering a world.

resources.name: Java Subtitles Animations (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack

resources.name: Better Combat Resources (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack
resources.summary: Fights get clearer with Better Combat Resources, a texture pack aimed at player-versus-player combat that improves visibility and clarity.

resources.name: Shield Indicator (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack

resources.name: Actual Glowing Ores (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack
resources.summary: Ores emit light in Actual Glowing Ores, a texture pack that makes coal, diamond and the rest easy to find even in the darkest caves.

resources.name: Better Items (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack
resources.summary: First-person item animations and item textures get reworked in Better Items, a texture pack that retextures items and entities at 16x.

resources.name: Suvile’s Tiny Tools for (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack

resources.name: Faithful Edition (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack

resources.name: Better Falling Leaves (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack
resources.summary: Leaves drift down from trees in Better Falling Leaves, a texture pack that adds falling leaf animations and new particle textures.

resources.name: ezRTX (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Shader

resources.name: Quick Loot & Crafting (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack
resources.summary: Chests and crafting get faster with Quick Loot & Crafting, a texture pack that retextures the user interface to speed up several actions.

resources.name: Hit Range (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack

resources.name: Completify (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack

resources.name: Enchantment Glint Customizer (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack

resources.name: Enhanced FX (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack

resources.name: Scary Fog (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack
resources.summary: A thick, eerie mist covers the whole world with Scary Fog, a themed texture pack for players who want more dread and mystery.

resources.name: Herobrine from the Fog Shader (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Shader
resources.summary: Thick fog, a deep lapis-blue sea and a cold, eerie tone make Herobrine from the Fog Shader a survival-minded shader for players who enable Vibrant Visuals.

resources.name: Zero Deferred (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Shader
resources.summary: Zero Deferred brings a modern local lighting system and a distinct visual style built for the Vibrant Visuals mode.

resources.name: Ale Pack RenderDragon (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Shader

resources.name: Player Hitbox (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack

resources.name: HUD Reworked (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack

resources.name: Invisible Armor (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack

resources.name: Dungeons UI (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack
resources.summary: A Dungeons-inspired look covers nearly every screen with Dungeons UI, a texture pack that retextures the user interface.

resources.name: Ferous Luna Shader (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Shader

resources.name: Look at My Skin (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack
resources.summary: Look at My Skin puts a small paper doll of the player into the user interface, so the character’s skin and equipped armor are always on screen.

resources.name: Dusk Dawn Shade (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Shader
resources.summary: Sunrise and sunset get the most attention in Dusk Dawn Shade, a shader that aims for a warm, tranquil look.

resources.name: Food Stats (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack

resources.name: My Mini 3D Totem (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack
resources.summary: My Mini 3D Totem replaces the Totem of Undying with a tiny three-dimensional model of the player.

resources.summary: GUI Overhaul gives the game’s menus a fresh look and lets players choose between a Light Mode and a Dark Mode.

resources.name: Ponky’s Transparent Shield (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack

resources.name: X-Ray Enhanced (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack

resources.name: More Beautiful Grass (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack
resources.summary: More Beautiful Grass raises the color saturation of grass blocks, giving landscapes a richer and more vivid green.

resources.name: Enhanced Tweaks (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack

resources.name: Stone D-pad (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack

resources.name: RGB Nether Portals (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack

resources.name: Borderless Glass (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack
resources.summary: Glass blocks lose their frames and become completely clear with Borderless Glass, a PBR texture pack that retextures blocks at 16x.

resources.name: Brewing Potions Guide (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack
resources.summary: A recipe guide sits right inside the brewing screen with Brewing Potions Guide, a texture pack that retextures the UI.

resources.summary: Plain gray menus give way to screens that match the blocks they belong to in Recolourful Containers GUI HUD, a texture pack that restyles the user interface.

resources.name: Krypton (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack

resources.name: F1 Button (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack

resources.name: Cartoon Clouds – Custom Sky (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack
resources.summary: A cartoon-style sky full of clouds like those in animated shows is what Cartoon Clouds – Custom Sky delivers.

resources.name: Relta Visuals (26+) – MCPE/Bedrock Shader
resources.summary: A cleaner, more straightforward look is the goal of Relta Visuals, a shader that refines lighting, adjusts color balance and tidies up the overall atmosphere.

resources.name: Item Tooltip Display (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack
resources.summary: Item descriptions show up at once with Item Tooltip Display, a texture pack that retextures the user interface to remove the need to hover over every item.

resources.summary: Skins with a second layer look deeper and bolder thanks to ThreeD Player Skin, a texture pack that turns the outer skin layer into a raised, three-dimensional effect.

resources.summary: A small waypoint icon in place of the word Coordinates, and a clock beside the Days played counter, are the two main edits in Better Coord And Days.

resources.name: Dynamic Bossbar (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack

resources.name: Roundista (26+, 1.21) – MCPE/Bedrock Texture Pack
